description: ALF’s first year with the Tanners turns one suburban household into a permanent hiding operation. As Gordon Shumway learns Earth customs, television, money and family life, Willie and Kate try to keep their destructive houseguest secret from the Ochmoneks and the government while ALF slowly becomes part of the family.

s01e01.description: Gordon Shumway crash-lands in the Tanner garage, forcing the family to hide the stranded Melmacian from the authorities.

s01e02.description: Left at home while the family goes out, ALF struggles to stay hidden from the Tanners’ suspicious neighbor while Brian is being watched.

s01e03.description: When Lucky disappears, ALF becomes the obvious suspect and searches for the family cat to prove he did not eat him.

s01e04.description: Brian is terrified of performing as an asparagus in a school play, and ALF tries to build up his confidence.

s01e05.description: ALF uses Willie’s radio to contact the President about nuclear weapons, accidentally making Willie look like a dangerous caller.

s01e06.description: Trying to help with the household finances, ALF takes up selling cosmetics and predictably turns the venture into domestic chaos.

s01e07.description: Lonely and unable to meet people normally, ALF forms a friendship with Jody, a blind woman who can know him without seeing what he is.

s01e08.description: Homesick for Melmac and the woman he loved there, ALF tries to discover whether anyone else survived the planet’s destruction.

s01e09.description: ALF grows jealous when Lynn’s musician boyfriend spends time at the house and tries to win her attention for himself.

s01e10.description: An old list of unrealized ambitions sends Willie into a midlife reckoning, with ALF enthusiastically pushing him to finish it.

s01e11.description: After the Tanners’ car troubles continue, ALF decides the sensible solution is to buy Lynn a car himself.

s01e12.description: The Tanners take ALF camping to avoid leaving him home alone, only for the supposedly safe wilderness trip to become a rescue mission.

s01e13.description: ALF experiences his first Earth Christmas and joins Willie in an increasingly troublesome search for a proper Christmas tree.

s01e14.description: Kate’s difficult relationship with her visiting mother Dorothy becomes even more complicated when the family decides to introduce her to ALF.

s01e15.description: Convinced he can improve a television soap opera, ALF writes and submits his own script to the show.

s01e16.description: ALF meddles in Dorothy’s romantic life by trying to bring her together with Whizzer.

s01e17.description: ALF befriends a Mexican teenager who is far from home and wants to return to his family.

s01e18.description: A periodic Melmacian transformation makes ALF dangerously erratic, forcing the Tanners to try to keep him confined until it passes.

s01e19.description: Exhausted by the constant deception required to hide ALF, Willie secretly begins seeing a therapist.

s01e20.description: During a blackout, ALF spies on the Ochmoneks and becomes convinced that Trevor has murdered Raquel.

s01e21.description: ALF discovers horse-race betting and quickly convinces himself he can solve the Tanners’ money problems through gambling.

s01e22.description: ALF helps Brian with a school science project and introduces some distinctly Melmacian corrections to the solar system.

s01e23.description: A cockroach that arrived aboard ALF’s spacecraft grows to monstrous size inside the Tanner home.

s01e24-25.description: After an accident leaves ALF with amnesia, the Tanners revisit earlier adventures in an effort to restore his identity and memory.

s01e26.description: ALF secretly joins the Tanners and Ochmoneks on a flying vacation, where his presence becomes unexpectedly useful when the trip goes wrong.
